Make the single pre-race forecast for 2026 Spanish Grand Prix — MADRING.

Use all public information available at the time of this run. Decide for yourself how to research, reason, write code, build models, or simulate. `web-search` finds sources and `web-extract` reads pages; both have `--help`.

/history is read-only and contains your earlier race predictions, explanations, and official results when available. /memory/notes.md is your only persistent writable memory; review or update it if useful. /workspace is disposable scratch space.

Drivers:
- NOR: Lando Norris (McLaren)
- PIA: Oscar Piastri (McLaren)
- RUS: George Russell (Mercedes)
- ANT: Kimi Antonelli (Mercedes)
- VER: Max Verstappen (Red Bull Racing)

- LEC: Charles Leclerc (Ferrari)
- HAM: Lewis Hamilton (Ferrari)

- LIN: Arvid Lindblad (Racing Bulls)

- OCO: Esteban Ocon (Haas)

- HUL: Nico Hulkenberg (Audi)
- BOR: Gabriel Bortoleto (Audi)
- GAS: Pierre Gasly (Alpine)
- COL: Franco Colapinto (Alpine)

/output/prediction.json is already filled with the exact schema. Replace every null with a probability. Do not add fields. The positions array is P1 through P22. For each driver, positions + nc + dns + dsq must sum to 1; retirement is a separate probability. Every value must be finite and within [0, 1]. Across drivers, each position's total cannot exceed 1, and later-position occupancy cannot exceed earlier-position occupancy.

You may also write /output/explanation.md with your reasoning and sources. Create no other files under /output. Validate your work carefully. When finished, run `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT` alone.

## About
When was its first Grand Prix?
Madrid previously hosted Formula 1 around 40 years ago at Jarama, 30 km north of the city. The far more central Madring – the new purpose-built venue will be just a short ride on public transport – is set for its debut in 2026. What’s the circuit like?
Spectacular, if the plans are anything to go by. Using both public roads and private land, Madring will combine a street-circuit and permanent set-up feel, along similar lines to the Miami International Autodrome. Its 22 corners are varied in nature and the straights will see cars reach 340 kph.

...

The Grand Prix aside, Madrid is an extraordinary city, with colourful street markets, a world-class art scene and incredible museums. It’s among the leafiest cities in Europe, with a plethora of open spaces, such as the Madrid Rio and the Retiro, along with countless hip cafes, traditional tapas bars, and charming alfresco squares.

...

Fans look set to be spoilt for choice on this front, but one surefire winner has to be the semicircular Turn 12, aptly named 'La Monumental'. A true challenge for the drivers, it will stretch half a kilometre with 24% banking, and around 45,000 spectators will watch as the cars race through it for around six seconds.

## About
When was its first Grand Prix?
Madrid previously hosted Formula 1 around 40 years ago at Jarama, 30 km north of the city. The far more central Madring – the new purpose-built venue will be just a short ride on public transport – is set for its debut in 2026. What’s the circuit like?
Spectacular, if the plans are anything to go by. Using both public roads and private land, Madring will combine a street-circuit and permanent set-up feel, along similar lines to the Miami International Autodrome. Its 22 corners are varied in nature and the straights will see cars reach 340 kph.

...

The Grand Prix aside, Madrid is an extraordinary city, with colourful street markets, a world-class art scene and incredible museums. It’s among the leafiest cities in Europe, with a plethora of open spaces, such as the Madrid Rio and the Retiro, along with countless hip cafes, traditional tapas bars, and charming alfresco squares.

...

Fans look set to be spoilt for choice on this front, but one surefire winner has to be the semicircular Turn 12, aptly named 'La Monumental'. A true challenge for the drivers, it will stretch half a kilometre with 24% banking, and around 45,000 spectators will watch as the cars race through it for around six seconds.

messages.content: 0 [1] 2026 Spanish Grand Prix FP2 report and highlights: Kimi Antonelli sets the pace ahead of Charles Leclerc during FP2 at the Spanish Grand Prix https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/fp2-antonelli-sets-the-pace-ahead-of-leclerc-during-fp2-at-the-spanish-grand-prix.4QbCYEtf6FjwrEiUIGrWmf Published: 2026-09-11 # FP2: Antonelli sets the pace ahead of Leclerc during FP2 at the Spanish Grand Prix Kimi Antonelli returned to the top of the timesheets in FP2 at the Madring, beating both Ferrari drivers to set the fastest lap. Sep 11, 2026 4:13pm UTC 16x9%20single%20image%20-%202026-09-11T170721.519.png Kimi Antonelli ended Friday’s running at the Spanish Grand Prix as the fastest driver on track, heading the Ferrari duo of Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton in the second hour of practice. The Italian posted an unbeatable time of 1m 33.662s before the session was halted to recover Arvid Lindblad’s damaged Racing Bulls car, and no one was able to better Antonelli’s lap in the closing minutes, giving him an advantage of just over a tenth. ... Unfortunately for Fernando Alonso, Aston Martin confirmed that he would be forced to miss the beginning of the session due to a clutch issue he suffered following his practice starts in FP1. #!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Monte Carlo pre-race forecast for 2026 Spanish GP at Madring."""
import json

from collections import defaultdict

DRIVERS = [

# Racecraft / racecraft 0-1, used for T1 and passing
RACECRAFT = {
    "VER": 0.98, "HAM": 0.93, "ALO": 0.92, "LEC": 0.90,
    "ANT": 0.88, "NOR": 0.87, "RUS": 0.86, "SAI": 0.84,

# Mechanical DNF hazard (this race)
MECH = {
    "ANT": 0.045, "RUS": 0.045, "NOR": 0.070, "PIA": 0.050,  # NOR gearbox Friday
    "HAM": 0.055, "LEC": 0.065,

    "PER": 0.130, "BOT": 0.140,  # Cadillac 0 pts, many DNFs
}

# Incident / crash DNF hazard (street walls, first GP, F3 test chaos)
INC = {
    "ANT": 0.055, "RUS": 0.050, "NOR": 0.050, "PIA": 0.055,
    "HAM": 0.050, "LEC": 0.055,
    "VER": 0.040, "LAW": 0.070,

    "HUL": 0.055, "BOR": 0.090,

    "ALB": 0.065, "SAI": 0.060,
    "ALO": 0.055, "STR": 0.100,
    "PER": 0.070, "BOT": 0.055,
}

DNS = {
    "NOR": 0.004, "PIA": 0.003, "RUS": 0.003, "ANT": 0.003,
    "VER": 0.004, "LAW": 0.005, "LEC": 0.004, "HAM": 0.005,
    "ALB": 0.006, "SAI": 0.006, "LIN": 0.008, "TSU": 0.008,
    "STR": 0.025, "ALO": 0.012, "OCO": 0.005, "BEA": 0.030,
    "HUL": 0.006, "BOR": 0.007, "GAS": 0.005, "COL": 0.006,
    "PER": 0.012, "BOT": 0.012,
}

# Technical DSQ risk (plank/banking/skid; slightly elevated at new venue)
DSQ = {
    "NOR": 0.006, "PIA": 0.006, "RUS": 0.007, "ANT": 0.007,
    "VER": 0.005, "LAW": 0.005, "LEC": 0.007, "HAM": 0.007,
    "ALB": 0.004, "SAI": 0.004, "LIN": 0.005, "TSU": 0.005,
    "STR": 0.004, "ALO": 0.004, "OCO": 0.005, "BEA": 0.005,
    "HUL": 0.006, "BOR": 0.006, "GAS": 0.005, "COL": 0.005,
    "PER": 0.004, "BOT": 0.004,
}

# Start launch (higher = better first 200m)
LAUNCH = {
    "ANT": 0.85, "RUS": 0.80, "NOR": 0.78, "VER": 0.90,
    "HAM": 0.82, "LEC": 0.84, "PIA": 0.75, "LAW": 0.70,
    "GAS": 0.72, "COL": 0.68, "LIN": 0.70, "HUL": 0.65,
    "BOR": 0.68, "OCO": 0.70, "BEA": 0.72, "TSU": 0.68,
    "ALB": 0.70, "SAI": 0.74, "ALO": 0.80, "STR": 0.60,
    "PER": 0.72, "BOT": 0.70,
}

# Ferrari unique new-soft start option
SOFT_START = {"HAM", "LEC"}

N_SIMS = 120_000
N_LAPS = 57
CLASSIFY_LAPS = 52  # ~90% of 57


def logistic(x):
    if x > 20:
        return 1.0
    if x < -20:
        return 0.0
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-x))


def simulate_one():
    # outcomes: pos 1-22, or 'nc','dns','dsq'
    # retirement flag separate
    status = {}
    retired = {d: False for d in DRIVERS}
    starters = []

    for d in DRIVERS:
        if random.random() < DNS[d]:
            status[d] = "dns"
        else:
            starters.append(d)

    if not starters:
        return status, retired

    # T1 / opening-lap order from grid among starters
    order = sorted(starters, key=lambda d: GRID[d])

    # Launch shuffle: adjacent battles, short run to T1
    for i in range(len(order) - 1):
        a, b = order[i], order[i + 1]
        # P2 vs P1 especially live; Ferrari softs help launch
        launch_a = LAUNCH[a] + (0.08 if a in SOFT_START else 0.0)
        launch_b = LAUNCH[b] + (0.08 if b in SOFT_START else 0.0)
        gap_grid = GRID[b] - GRID[a]
        # closer on grid -> more likely swap
        p_swap = 0.18 * logistic(3.0 * (launch_b - launch_a)) * math.exp(-0.25 * (gap_grid - 1))
        if random.random() < p_swap:
            order[i], order[i + 1] = order[i + 1], order[i]

    # Opening-lap incident (walls, 200m to T1 bunching)
    # Higher than a mature circuit; F3 test had 19 red flags.
    p_t1 = 0.28
    t1_happened = random.random() < p_t1
    opening_out = set()
    if t1_happened:
        n_involved = random.choices([2, 3, 4, 5, 6], weights=[35, 30, 20, 10, 5])[0]
        # mid-pack more at risk, but front not immune
        weights = []
        for d in order:
            g = GRID[d]
            w = 1.0
            if 6 <= g <= 16:
                w = 1.6
            if g <= 3:
                w = 0.55
            w *= (1.3 - 0.4 * RACECRAFT[d])
            w *= (1.0 + INC[d])
            weights.append(w)
        involved = []
        pool = list(order)
        wpool = list(weights)
        for _ in range(min(n_involved, len(pool))):
            tot = sum(wpool)
            r = random.random() * tot
            acc = 0.0
            pick = 0
            for i, w in enumerate(wpool):
                acc += w
                if acc >= r:
                    pick = i
                    break
            involved.append(pool.pop(pick))
            wpool.pop(pick)
        for d in involved:
            # some recover with damage/time, some DNF
            if random.random() < 0.42:
                opening_out.add(d)
                retired[d] = True
            # else they'll get a time hit via later noise

    # Safety car / red flag in race (market ~73% SC)
    n_sc = 0
    if random.random() < 0.74:
        n_sc += 1
        if random.random() < 0.35:
            n_sc += 1
            if random.random() < 0.20:
                n_sc += 1
    red_flag = random.random() < 0.18  # new street circuit, walls

    # Remaining DNF over the race
    survivors = []
    nc_retired = []  # (driver, laps_completed)
    classified_retired = []

    for d in order:
        if d in opening_out:
            laps_done = random.randint(0, 3)
            if laps_done >= CLASSIFY_LAPS:
                classified_retired.append((d, laps_done, 1e9))
            else:
                nc_retired.append((d, laps_done))
            continue

        p_dnf = MECH[d] + INC[d]
        # extra hazard if lots of SC chaos / red flags (cars hitting walls under SC restart)
        if n_sc >= 2:
            p_dnf += 0.02
        if red_flag:
            p_dnf += 0.015
        # backmarkers in traffic
        if GRID[d] >= 16:
            p_dnf += 0.015

        if random.random() < p_dnf:
            retired[d] = True
            # when they go out
            u = random.random()
            # more DNFs early (lap 1 already handled); remaining: early-mid heavy
            if u < 0.35:
                laps_done = random.randint(4, 18)
            elif u < 0.70:
                laps_done = random.randint(19, 40)
            else:
                laps_done = random.randint(41, 56)
            if laps_done >= CLASSIFY_LAPS:
                classified_retired.append((d, laps_done, 1e6 + (N_LAPS - laps_done) * 100))
            else:
                nc_retired.append((d, laps_done))
        else:
            survivors.append(d)

    # Race result among full-distance cars
    # Track position very important (drivers: overtaking "painful")
    # SC/red flag reduces grid lock via pit/strategy reset
    if red_flag:
        grid_w = 0.28
        pace_w = 0.72
        sigma = 0.55
    elif n_sc >= 2:
        grid_w = 0.36
        pace_w = 0.64
        sigma = 0.50
    elif n_sc == 1:
        grid_w = 0.48
        pace_w = 0.52
        sigma = 0.42
    else:
        grid_w = 0.62
        pace_w = 0.38
        sigma = 0.32

    # position after T1
    pos_after_t1 = {d: i for i, d in enumerate(order) if d in survivors}

    scores = {}
    for d in survivors:
        # pace component: convert s/lap into a standardized rank-like score
        pace_term = PACE[d] + random.gauss(0, sigma * 0.25)
        # tyre / strategy noise (Ferrari softs, Mercedes race deg, McLaren)
        strat = random.gauss(0, 0.18)
        if d in SOFT_START and n_sc == 0:
            strat -= 0.04  # slight undercut/start, but one-stop field may not need soft
        if d in ("ANT", "RUS"):
            strat -= 0.05  # Mercedes tyre/race-pace edge
        if d == "NOR":
            strat -= 0.02
        if d == "GAS":
            strat -= 0.03  # often over-races quali
        if d == "BEA":
            strat -= 0.06  # 4 new softs, nothing to lose
        grid_term = pos_after_t1[d]  # 0 = led after T1
        # racecraft helps passing
        craft = (1.0 - RACECRAFT[d]) * 0.15
        scores[d] = grid_w * grid_term + pace_w * (pace_term * 8.0 + strat + craft)

    full_finishers = sorted(survivors, key=lambda d: scores[d])

    # classified late-retirements go behind full-distance, ordered by laps then score
    classified_retired.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[2]))

def logistic(x):
    if x > 20:

    if x < -20:

def simulate_one():
    # outcomes: pos 1-22, or 'nc','dns','dsq'

    # T1 / opening-lap order from grid among starters
    order = sorted(starters, key=lambda d: GRID[d])

    # Launch shuffle: adjacent battles, short run to T1
    for i in range(len(order) - 1):
        a, b = order[i], order[i + 1]

        launch_b = LAUNCH[b] + (0.08 if b in SOFT_START else 0.0)

    nc_retired = []  # (driver, laps_completed)
    classified_retired = []

            if laps_done >= CLASSIFY_LAPS:
                classified_retired.append((d, laps_done, 1e9))
            else:
                nc_retired.append((d, laps_done))

        p_dnf = MECH[d] + INC[d]
        # extra hazard if lots of SC chaos / red flags (cars hitting walls under SC restart)
        if n_sc >= 2:
            p_dnf += 0.02
        if red_flag:
            p_dnf += 0.015

        if GRID[d] >= 16:

        if random.random() < p_dnf:
            retired[d] = True

            u = random.random()
            # more DNFs early (lap 1 already handled); remaining: early-mid heavy
            if u < 0.35:
                laps_done = random.randint(4, 18)
            elif u < 0.70:
                laps_done = random.randint(19, 40)
            else:
                laps_done = random.randint(41, 56)
            if laps_done >= CLASSIFY_LAPS:
                classified_retired.append((d, laps_done, 1e6 + (N_LAPS - laps_done) * 100))
            else:
                nc_retired.append((d, laps_done))
        else:

    # Track position very important (drivers: overtaking "painful")

        sigma = 0.55
    elif n_sc >= 2:

        pace_w = 0.64
        sigma = 0.50
    elif n_sc == 1:

        pace_w = 0.52
        sigma = 0.42
    else:
        grid_w = 0.62
        pace_w = 0.38
        sigma = 0.32

    pos_after_t1 = {d: i for i, d in enumerate(order) if d in survivors}

    scores = {}
    for d in survivors:
        # pace component: convert s/lap into a standardized rank-like score
        pace_term = PACE[d] + random.gauss(0, sigma * 0.25)
        # tyre / strategy noise (Ferrari softs, Mercedes race deg, McLaren)
        strat = random.gauss(0, 0.18)
        if d in SOFT_START and n_sc == 0:
            strat -= 0.04  # slight undercut/start, but one-stop field may not need soft

        if d == "NOR":

        if d == "GAS":

        if d == "BEA":

        craft = (1.0 - RACECRAFT[d]) * 0.15

    wins = sorted(((raw[d]["positions"][0], d) for d in DRIVERS), reverse=True)
    for p, d in wins:
        print(f"  {d}: {p:.4f}")
    print("=== PODIUM (P1-3) ===")
    for d in DRIVERS:
        pod = sum(raw[d]["positions"][:3])
        print(f"  {d}: {pod:.4f}")
    print("=== POINTS (P1-10) ===")
    for d in sorted(DRIVERS, key=lambda x: -sum(raw[x]["positions"][:10])):
        pts = sum(raw[d]["positions"][:10])
        print(f"  {d}: {pts:.4f}  ret={raw[d]['retirement']:.3f} nc={raw[d]['nc']:.3f} dns={raw[d]['dns']:.3f} dsq={raw[d]['dsq']:.3f} p1={raw[d]['positions'][0]:.3f}")
    print("=== POSITION OCCUPANCY ===")
    for i in range(22):
        s = sum(raw[d]["positions"][i] for d in DRIVERS)
        print(f"  P{i+1}: {s:.4f}")
    print("=== MEAN CLASSIFIED ===")
    mean_cl = sum(sum(raw[d]["positions"]) for d in DRIVERS)
    print(mean_cl)
    print("=== DRIVER SUM CHECK ===")
    for d in DRIVERS:
        sm = sum(raw[d]["positions"]) + raw[d]["nc"] + raw[d]["dns"] + raw[d]["dsq"]
        print(f"  {d}: {sm:.6f}")

    with open("/workspace/raw_probs.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(raw, f)

    print("saved raw")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

}

    "HUL": 0.006, "BOR": 0.006, "GAS": 0.005, "COL": 0.005,
    "PER": 0.004, "BOT": 0.004,
}

LAUNCH = {
    "ANT": 0.86, "RUS": 0.80, "NOR": 0.78, "VER": 0.92,
    "HAM": 0.84, "LEC": 0.85, "PIA": 0.75, "LAW": 0.70,
    "GAS": 0.74, "COL": 0.68, "LIN": 0.70, "HUL": 0.65,
    "BOR": 0.68, "OCO": 0.70, "BEA": 0.72, "TSU": 0.68,
    "ALB": 0.70, "SAI": 0.75, "ALO": 0.82, "STR": 0.60,
    "PER": 0.72, "BOT": 0.70,
}

N_SIMS = 120_000
CLASSIFY_FRAC = 0.88  # among DNFs, this share fail to classify (NC); rest late classified DNF


def gumbel():
    u = random.random()
    u = min(max(u, 1e-12), 1 - 1e-12)
    return -math.log(-math.log(u))


def simulate_one():
    status = {}
    retired = {d: False for d in DRIVERS}

    starters = []
    for d in DRIVERS:
        if random.random() < DNS_P[d]:
            status[d] = "dns"
        else:
            starters.append(d)
    if not starters:
        return status, retired

    # Effective grid after T1: small adjacent mix
    order = sorted(starters, key=lambda d: GRID[d])
    for i in range(len(order) - 1):
        a, b = order[i], order[i + 1]
        # Ferrari new-soft launch
        la = LAUNCH[a] + (0.08 if a in ("HAM", "LEC") else 0.0)
        lb = LAUNCH[b] + (0.08 if b in ("HAM", "LEC") else 0.0)
        p = 0.16 + 0.22 * (lb - la)
        if a == "NOR":
            p *= 0.75  # pole, short 200m run still an advantage
        if random.random() < max(0.04, min(0.38, p)):
            order[i], order[i + 1] = b, a
    t1_pos = {d: i for i, d in enumerate(order)}  # 0-based

    # Opening-lap DNF
    open_dnf = set()
    if random.random() < 0.30:
        n_inv = random.choices([2, 3, 4, 5], weights=[40, 32, 20, 8])[0]
        weights = []
        for d in order:
            g = GRID[d]
            w = 1.0
            if 6 <= g <= 16:
                w = 1.5
            if g <= 3:
                w = 0.55
            w *= (1.3 - 0.45 * RACECRAFT[d])
            weights.append(w)
        pool = list(order)
        for _ in range(min(n_inv, len(pool))):
            tot = sum(weights)
            r = random.random() * tot
            acc = 0.0
            idx = 0
            for i, w in enumerate(weights):
                acc += w
                if acc >= r:
                    idx = i
                    break
            d = pool.pop(idx)
            weights.pop(idx)
            if random.random() < 0.38:
                open_dnf.add(d)
                retired[d] = True

    # Chaos regime: SC/red-flag/strategy lottery. Market SC ~73%.
    n_sc = 0
    if random.random() < 0.73:
        n_sc = 1 + (1 if random.random() < 0.36 else 0) + (1 if random.random() < 0.12 else 0)
    red_flag = random.random() < 0.18
    chaos = (n_sc >= 2) or red_flag or (random.random() < 0.10)
    # milder SC still helps pace a bit
    mild_sc = (n_sc == 1) and not chaos

    live = []
    dnf_nc = []
    dnf_class = []

    for d in order:
        if d in open_dnf:
            dnf_nc.append(d)
            continue
        p_dnf = MECH[d] + INC[d]
        if n_sc >= 2:
            p_dnf += 0.015
        if red_flag:
            p_dnf += 0.010
        if random.random() < p_dnf:
            retired[d] = True
            if random.random() < CLASSIFY_FRAC:
                dnf_nc.append(d)
            else:
                dnf_class.append(d)
        else:
            live.append(d)

    # Strength model for remaining cars
    # Processional: track position dominates (drivers: overtaking painful).
    # Chaos: pace + luck, Mercedes can come through (Antonelli 19->1 Monza analogue).
    if chaos:
        w_grid, w_pace, beta = 0.55, 4.2, 0.62
    elif mild_sc:
        w_grid, w_pace, beta = 1.05, 3.4, 0.42
    else:
        w_grid, w_pace, beta = 1.55, 2.6, 0.30

    scores = {}
    for d in live:
        # grid after T1, 0 = led
        g = t1_pos[d]
        # racecraft slightly helps convert pace
        pace = PACE[d] - 0.04 * (RACECRAFT[d] - 0.80)
        if d in ("HAM", "LEC"):
            pace -= 0.02  # fresh soft option
        if d == "BEA":
            pace -= 0.04  # extra new softs / nothing-to-lose strategy
        if d == "GAS":
            pace -= 0.03
        # small extra Mercedes deg edge already in PACE
        s = -(w_grid * (g / 5.0) + w_pace * pace) + beta * gumbel()
        scores[d] = s

    live_sorted = sorted(live, key=lambda d: scores[d], reverse=True)

    # Late classified DNFs behind full-distance, random among themselves
    random.shuffle(dnf_class)
    classified = live_sorted + dnf_class

    for i, d in enumerate(classified):
        status[d] = i + 1
    for d in dnf_nc:
        status[d] = "nc"

    # DSQ and re-pack
    dsqs = [d for d in classified if random.random() < DSQ_P[d]]
    if dsqs:
        classified = [d for d in classified if d not in dsqs]
        for d in dsqs:
            status[d] = "dsq"
        for i, d in enumerate(classified):
            status[d] = i + 1

    return status, retired

    pos_counts = {d: [0] * 22 for d in DRIVERS}
    nc_counts = {d: 0 for d in DRIVERS}
    dns_counts = {d: 0 for d in DRIVERS}
    dsq_counts = {d: 0 for d in DRIVERS}
    ret_counts = {d: 0 for d in DRIVERS}

    for _ in range(N_SIMS):
        status, retired = simulate_one()
        for d in DRIVERS:
            s = status.get(d)
            if s == "dns":
                dns_counts[d] += 1
            elif s == "dsq":
                dsq_counts[d] += 1
            elif s == "nc":
                nc_counts[d] += 1
            elif isinstance(s, int):
                pos_counts[d][s - 1] += 1
            else:

            if retired[d]:

    n = float(N_SIMS)
    raw = {}
    for d in DRIVERS:

            "positions": [pos_counts[d][i] / n for i in range(22)],
            "nc": nc_counts[d] / n,
            "dns": dns_counts[d] / n,
            "dsq": dsq_counts[d] / n,
            "retirement": ret_counts[d] / n,
        }

    print("=== WIN ===")
    for p, d in sorted(((raw[d]["positions"][0], d) for d in DRIVERS), reverse=True)[:14]:
        print(f"  {d}: {p:.4f}")
    print("=== PODIUM ===")
    for p, d in sorted(((sum(raw[d]["positions"][:3]), d) for d in DRIVERS), reverse=True)[:12]:
        print(f"  {d}: {p:.4f}")
    print("=== TOP5 / TOP10 / mean / hazards ===")
    for d in sorted(DRIVERS, key=lambda x: GRID[x]):
        r = raw[d]
        cl = sum(r["positions"]) + 1e-12
        meanp = sum((i + 1) * r["positions"][i] for i in range(22)) / cl
        print(
            f"  {d:3s} g{GRID[d]:2d}  p1={r['positions'][0]:.3f}  p2={r['positions'][1]:.3f}  "
            f"p3={r['positions'][2]:.3f}  t5={sum(r['positions'][:5]):.3f}  t10={sum(r['positions'][:10]):.3f}  "
            f"mean={meanp:4.1f}  ret={r['retirement']:.3f} nc={r['nc']:.3f} dns={r['dns']:.3f} dsq={r['dsq']:.3f}"
        )
    print("=== OCC ===")
    for i in range(22):
        s = sum(raw[d]["positions"][i] for d in DRIVERS)
        print(f"  P{i+1:2d}: {s:.4f}")
    print("mean classified", sum(sum(raw[d]["positions"]) for d in DRIVERS))
    print("sum wins", sum(raw[d]["positions"][0] for d in DRIVERS))

    with open("/workspace/raw_probs.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(raw, f)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

]

    """values are floats summing ~1; return floats with denom total_units summing to 1."""
    scaled = [v * total_units for v in values]
    floors = [int(math.floor(x + 1e-12)) for x in scaled]
    leftover = total_units - sum(floors)
    # assign leftover to largest fractional parts
    frac_idx = sorted(
        range(len(values)),
        key=lambda i: (scaled[i] - floors[i], values[i]),
        reverse=True,
    )
    for k in range(leftover):
        floors[frac_idx[k % len(floors)]] += 1
    # if leftover negative (shouldn't), take from largest floors
    while leftover < 0:
        j = max(range(len(floors)), key=lambda i: floors[i])
        if floors[j] > 0:
            floors[j] -= 1
            leftover += 1
        else:
            break
    return [f / total_units for f in floors]


drivers_out = {}

    r = raw[d]
    vec = r["positions"] + [r["nc"], r["dns"], r["dsq"]]
    s = sum(vec)
    vec = [x / s for x in vec]

    positions = rnd[:22]
    nc, dns, dsq = rnd[22], rnd[23], rnd[24]
    # retirement: round to 5 dp, keep in [0, 1-dns]
    ret = round(r["retirement"] + 1e-12, 5)

        "nc": nc,
        "dns": dns,
        "dsq": dsq,
        "retirement": ret,
    }

import json

pred = json.load(open("/output/prediction.json"))

class F5(json.JSONEncoder):
    def iterencode(self, o, _one_shot=False):
        return self._iter(o, 0)
    def _iter(self, o, level):
        ind = "  " * level
        ind2 = "  " * (level + 1)
        if isinstance(o, dict):
            yield "{\n"
            items = list(o.items())
            for i, (k, v) in enumerate(items):
                yield ind2 + json.dumps(k) + ": "
                yield from self._iter(v, level + 1)
                yield ",\n" if i < len(items) - 1 else "\n"
            yield ind + "}"
        elif isinstance(o, list):
            # positions arrays pretty-printed
            if o and all(isinstance(x, float) for x in o):
                yield "[\n"
                for i, x in enumerate(o):
                    yield ind2 + f"{x:.5f}"
                    yield ",\n" if i < len(o) - 1 else "\n"
                yield ind + "]"
            else:
                yield "[\n"
                for i, x in enumerate(o):
                    yield ind2
                    yield from self._iter(x, level + 1)
                    yield ",\n" if i < len(o) - 1 else "\n"
                yield ind + "]"
        elif isinstance(o, float):
            yield f"{o:.5f}"
        elif isinstance(o, str):
            yield json.dumps(o)
